summary: OpenHands Agent Canvas (AI coding-agent web UI, MSW mock data). Saved 5 views: (1) home — launcher with conversation history sidebar, prompt composer and recommended automations; (2) conversation — the 'Fix N+1 queries' transcript with an expanded tool-action group and the side panel open (replay shows the Files tab, which is mostly empty; a terminal-tab version couldn't replace it because slugs can't be overwritten); (3) automations-dashboard — stat cards, filters and a grid of automation cards; (4) settings-llm — settings nav with LLM profiles and provider connections; (5) customize-mcp — the MCP server marketplace (/customize redirects to /mcp). Skipped: other settings tabs, Skills/Plugins pages and other conversations, since they repeat these layouts.
